# Common Utils

> Modular Kotlin/Java utility libraries providing extension functions, DSLs, and helpers for common frameworks. Each module is independently consumable via Maven Central.

- Version: 4.1.0
- Group: com.pambrose.common-utils
- Repository: https://github.com/pambrose/common-utils
- Maven Central: https://central.sonatype.com/namespace/com.pambrose.common-utils
- License: Apache 2.0
- Kotlin: 2.4.20 (the `kotlin-scripting-*` artifacts are pinned to 2.4.10), JVM 17
- Base package: com.pambrose.common.*
- Install: `implementation("com.pambrose.common-utils:<module>:4.1.0")`
- Multiplatform: core-utils, json-utils, and ktor-client-utils are Kotlin Multiplatform (JVM, JS, wasmJs,
  Native — iOS/macOS/tvOS/watchOS/Linux/Windows); all other modules are JVM-only
- Maven (non-Gradle) consumers of the three multiplatform modules must use the `-jvm` artifact
  (e.g. `core-utils-jvm`); Gradle resolves the correct variant from the root coordinate


## Modules

Use core-utils for general Kotlin/Java utility needs. Other modules target specific frameworks — pick only what you need.

- [core-utils](core-utils/README.md): General-purpose Kotlin extensions and helpers (multiplatform). Use for string/number/collection operations, I/O, atomic delegates, date/time formatting and duration helpers (DateUtils; zone-neutral, no bundled tz database), reflection, version management. No framework dependencies. Foundation for most other modules.
- [json-utils](json-utils/README.md): Kotlinx.serialization helpers (multiplatform). Use for JsonElement navigation (`get` takes dot-notation paths; `getByPath` splits on `/`), type-safe extraction, format configs (pretty/raw/lenient/strict). Depends on: core-utils.
- [exposed-utils](exposed-utils/README.md): JetBrains Exposed SQL extensions. Use for custom SQL expressions, UPSERT, timed transactions, ResultRow helpers. Depends on: kotlin-logging.
- [redis-utils](redis-utils/README.md): Jedis client extensions. Use for Redis connection management and common operation patterns. Depends on: core-utils.
- [ktor-server-utils](ktor-server-utils/README.md): Ktor server extensions. Use for Heroku HTTPS redirect, response utilities, servlet integration. No longer depends on core-utils as of 4.0.0.
- [ktor-client-utils](ktor-client-utils/README.md): Ktor HTTP client DSL (multiplatform; `blockingGet` is JVM-only). Use for client configuration and request/response utilities. Declares no HTTP engine: js/wasmJs fall back to ktor-client-core's Js engine, but JVM and Native consumers must add one (CIO, Darwin, Curl, WinHttp) before the DSL creates a client. Depends on: ktor-client-core.
- [jetty-utils](jetty-utils/README.md): Jetty 12 (EE11) server DSL. Use for server config, lambda-based servlets (Jakarta Servlet 6.1), version endpoints. Depends on: Jetty EE11 servlet.
- [grpc-utils](grpc-utils/README.md): gRPC channel/server DSL. Use for TLS/SSL setup, server lifecycle, StreamObserver helpers. Ships the netty-tcnative BoringSSL native jars for Linux, macOS and Windows, so TLS uses OpenSSL there and the JDK provider elsewhere. Depends on: core-utils.
- [dropwizard-utils](dropwizard-utils/README.md): Dropwizard health-check DSL and ready-made backlog/map-size health checks. Depends on: Dropwizard metrics-healthchecks.
- [prometheus-utils](prometheus-utils/README.md): Prometheus metrics DSL. Use for counters/gauges/histograms, system metrics, instrumented thread factories. Depends on: Prometheus simpleclient.
- [zipkin-utils](zipkin-utils/README.md): DSL for building a Brave `Tracing` that reports to Zipkin. Use for distributed tracing configuration. Depends on: core-utils.
- [script-utils-kotlin](script-utils-kotlin/README.md): Kotlin scripting engine. Use for Kotlin script execution, expression evaluation, and script pooling. Depends on: script-utils-common.
- [script-utils-java](script-utils-java/README.md): Java scripting engine. Use for compiling and evaluating Java source, with script pooling. Depends on: script-utils-common.
- [script-utils-python](script-utils-python/README.md): Jython engine. Use for Python 2.7 script execution and expression evaluation, with script pooling. Depends on: script-utils-common.
- [script-utils-common](script-utils-common/README.md): Base scripting interfaces. Abstract engines, script pools, evaluator frameworks. Foundation for script-utils-* modules.
- [service-utils](service-utils/README.md): Service lifecycle. Use for service base classes, admin interfaces, metrics/servlet/Zipkin service integration. Depends on: core-utils, guava-utils, ktor-server-utils, jetty-utils, dropwizard-utils, zipkin-utils (all `api`), and prometheus-utils.
- [guava-utils](guava-utils/README.md): Google Guava integration. Use for concurrent programming (BooleanMonitor, ConditionalValue, GenericMonitor), service lifecycle (GenericIdleService, GenericExecutionThreadService), thread-safe monitoring, GZIP compression helpers. Depends on: core-utils.
- [email-utils](email-utils/README.md): Email sending via the Resend API. Use for HTML email bodies, address validation, and decoding Resend webhook payloads (signature verification is not included). Depends on: core-utils.
- [recaptcha-utils](recaptcha-utils/README.md): Google reCAPTCHA server-side verification via the Ktor HTTP client. Use for token validation in a Ktor route, plus the script and widget helpers. Depends on: core-utils.
- common-utils-bom: A Maven BOM / Gradle platform (from 5.0.0). Import it with `platform(...)` or a `<scope>import</scope>` entry to align every module, including the `-jvm` artifacts of the multiplatform ones, on one version.

- [grpc-utils API details](grpc-utils/README.md): Channel/server DSL, TLS configuration, certificate management

- [guava-utils API details](guava-utils/README.md): Concurrent utilities, service lifecycle, GZIP compression
